description:
The US Forest Service will be hosting an Industry Day event in Boise on May 12, 2026 (9AM to 4PM) to discuss Aviation Contracting issues in the wildland fire support realm. We plan to have participation from our partner Agencies (DOI) and have a variety of US Forest Service personnel from the program and contracting side.

Please RSVP to event using the attached Micorsoft Forms Link: https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=5zZb7e4BvE6GfuA8-g1GlzyS8QqGhEZPngEBBtCE_6lUQTZISk9HRUoyUzY5RDRXTE1NNk5RVzhaWC4u

Draft Agenda has been posted (5/6/2026)

Also, a note on parking- we have 80 spots available during the daytime on the 3rd or 4th floor levels. The basement is reserved for Simplot Employee Parking. There are also other nearby garages at the locations below.

10th & Front
9th & Front
11th & Front
